```{r}
# Model B: eight-variable interaction analysis with Model A long-term income.
# Only the SECOND analysis from B_interaction Test(1).rmd is retained.
# Income = household mean of available 2011/2013/2015/2018/2020 annual per-capita incomes.
# Fixed T1/T2/T3 cutoffs are the exact Model A cutoffs; NO CPI adjustment.
# All other B1 start-stop, covariate, Dibao, ADL/IADL and interaction rules are retained.

# 0. Settings and packages
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA_DIR <- "."
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "B_Interaction_outputs")
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

required_packages <- c("survival", "openxlsx")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_packages, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}

library(survival)
library(openxlsx)
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

waves <- c(2011, 2013, 2015, 2018, 2020)
start_waves <- c(2011, 2013, 2015, 2018)
next_wave_lookup <- c("2011" = 2013,
                      "2013" = 2015,
                      "2015" = 2018,
                      "2018" = 2020)

# Keep the existing filenames and working directory.
# Prefer the original CSV inputs; use the same-named XLSX only if CSV is absent.
input_csv <- file.path(DATA_DIR, paste0("CHARLS_", waves, "_cleaned.csv"))
input_xlsx <- file.path(DATA_DIR, paste0("CHARLS_", waves, "_cleaned.xlsx"))
input_files <- setNames(
  ifelse(file.exists(input_csv), input_csv, input_xlsx),
  waves
)
file_adl <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "CHARLS_2011_2020_wide_ADL_IADL.xlsx")

if (any(!file.exists(input_files))) {
  stop("Missing cleaned wave file(s) for: ",
       paste(names(input_files)[!file.exists(input_files)], collapse = ", "),
       ". Expected CHARLS_YYYY_cleaned.csv or CHARLS_YYYY_cleaned.xlsx.")
}
if (!file.exists(file_adl)) {
  stop("Missing ADL/IADL file: ", file_adl)
}


# 1. Helper functions
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
safe_numeric <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))

one_nonmissing <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(x[!is.na(x)])
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA)
  x[1]
}

standardize_2011_individual_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  out <- x
  idx <- !is.na(x) & nchar(x) == 11
  out[idx] <- paste0(substr(x[idx], 1, 9), "0", substr(x[idx], 10, 11))
  out
}

standardize_2011_household_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  out <- x
  idx <- !is.na(x) & nchar(x) == 9
  out[idx] <- paste0(x[idx], "0")
  out
}

recode_marriage <- function(x) {
  out <- rep("Unknown", length(x))
  out[x %in% c(1, 2, 7)] <- "Partnered"
  out[x == 5] <- "Widowed"
  out[x %in% c(3, 4)] <- "Separated-Divorced"
  out[x == 6] <- "Never married"
  factor(out,
         levels = c("Partnered", "Widowed", "Separated-Divorced",
                    "Never married", "Unknown"))
}

recode_children <- function(x) {
  out <- rep("Unknown", length(x))
  out[!is.na(x) & x == 0] <- "0"
  out[!is.na(x) & x == 1] <- "1"
  out[!is.na(x) & x == 2] <- "2"
  out[!is.na(x) & x >= 3] <- "3+"
  factor(out, levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3+", "Unknown"))
}

recode_coresidence <- function(x) {
  out <- rep("Unknown", length(x))
  out[!is.na(x) & x == 0] <- "No"
  out[!is.na(x) & x == 1] <- "Yes"
  factor(out, levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown"))
}

recode_age_group <- function(x) {
  cut(x,
      breaks = c(45, 55, 65, 75, 85, 95, Inf),
      right = FALSE,
      labels = c("45-54", "55-64", "65-74",
                 "75-84", "85-94", "95+"))
}

fit_cox_with_warnings <- function(formula, data) {
  warnings_seen <- character(0)
  fit <- withCallingHandlers(
    coxph(
      formula,
      data = data,
      ties = "efron",
      cluster = individual_id,
      robust = TRUE,
      x = TRUE,
      model = TRUE
    ),
    warning = function(w) {
      warnings_seen <<- c(warnings_seen, conditionMessage(w))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )
  list(fit = fit, warnings = unique(warnings_seen))
}

safe_cox_zph <- function(fit) {
  tryCatch(
    cox.zph(fit, transform = "km", terms = TRUE, global = TRUE),
    error = function(e) structure(
      list(message = conditionMessage(e)),
      class = "cox_zph_error"
    )
  )
}

get_global_ph_p <- function(ph_object) {
  if (inherits(ph_object, "cox_zph_error")) return(NA_real_)
  tab <- as.data.frame(ph_object$table)
  if (!("GLOBAL" %in% rownames(tab))) return(NA_real_)
  p_col <- if ("p" %in% names(tab)) "p" else names(tab)[ncol(tab)]
  as.numeric(tab["GLOBAL", p_col])
}

wald_block <- function(fit, coefficient_names) {
  b_all <- coef(fit)
  coefficient_names <- intersect(coefficient_names, names(b_all))

  if (length(coefficient_names) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(chisq = NA_real_, df = 0L, p_value = NA_real_,
                      status = "No interaction coefficients found"))
  }

  b <- b_all[coefficient_names]
  V <- vcov(fit)[coefficient_names, coefficient_names, drop = FALSE]

  if (any(!is.finite(b)) || any(!is.finite(V))) {
    return(data.frame(chisq = NA_real_, df = length(coefficient_names),
                      p_value = NA_real_,
                      status = "Non-finite coefficient/variance; inspect sparse cells"))
  }

  ee <- eigen(V, symmetric = TRUE)
  tol <- max(abs(ee$values)) * 1e-10
  keep <- ee$values > tol

  if (!any(keep)) {
    return(data.frame(chisq = NA_real_, df = 0L, p_value = NA_real_,
                      status = "Robust covariance block has rank 0"))
  }

  Vinv <- ee$vectors[, keep, drop = FALSE] %*%
    diag(1 / ee$values[keep], nrow = sum(keep)) %*%
    t(ee$vectors[, keep, drop = FALSE])

  W <- as.numeric(t(b) %*% Vinv %*% b)
  df <- sum(keep)

  data.frame(
    chisq = W,
    df = df,
    p_value = pchisq(W, df = df, lower.tail = FALSE),
    status = ifelse(df < length(coefficient_names),
                    "Reduced-rank robust Wald test", "OK")
  )
}

single_coef_stats <- function(fit, term) {
  b <- coef(fit)
  V <- vcov(fit)

  if (!(term %in% names(b)) ||
      !is.finite(b[term]) ||
      !is.finite(V[term, term])) {
    return(c(est = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }

  # unname() is essential here. coef(fit)[term] keeps the coefficient
  # name; without unname(), c(est = est, ...) creates names such as
  # "est.sexFemale" rather than "est", so downstream stats["est"] returns NA.
  est <- unname(b[term])
  se <- unname(sqrt(V[term, term]))
  p <- unname(2 * pnorm(abs(est / se), lower.tail = FALSE))
  c(est = est, se = se, p = p)
}

linear_combination_stats <- function(fit, weights) {
  b <- coef(fit)
  V <- vcov(fit)
  needed <- names(weights)

  if (any(!(needed %in% names(b))) ||
      any(!is.finite(b[needed])) ||
      any(!is.finite(V[needed, needed, drop = FALSE]))) {
    return(c(est = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }

  # Use only the requested coefficients: other terms may be aliased in
  # the large simultaneous-interaction sensitivity model.
  w <- unname(as.numeric(weights))
  b_sub <- unname(b[needed])
  V_sub <- V[needed, needed, drop = FALSE]
  variance <- as.numeric(t(w) %*% V_sub %*% w)
  if (!is.finite(variance) || variance <= 0) {
    return(c(est = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }
  est <- unname(sum(w * b_sub))
  se <- unname(sqrt(variance))
  p <- unname(2 * pnorm(abs(est / se), lower.tail = FALSE))
  c(est = est, se = se, p = p)
}

hr_ci <- function(stats) {
  # unname() is required here for the same reason as in single_coef_stats().
  # Without it, c(HR = exp(est)) can create a name such as "HR.est",
  # so downstream extraction with x["HR"] returns NA.
  est <- unname(stats["est"])
  se <- unname(stats["se"])
  if (!is.finite(est) || !is.finite(se)) {
    return(c(HR = NA_real_, lower_95 = NA_real_, upper_95 = NA_real_))
  }
  c(HR = unname(exp(est)),
    lower_95 = unname(exp(est - 1.96 * se)),
    upper_95 = unname(exp(est + 1.96 * se)))
}

safe_name <- function(x) {
  z <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)
  gsub("_+$", "", z)
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Read and standardize the five cleaned files
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
raw_list <- list()

for (yr in waves) {
  input_file <- input_files[as.character(yr)]
  if (grepl("\\.csv$", input_file, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    d <- read.csv(
      input_file,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      na.strings = c("", "NA"),
      colClasses = c(individual_id = "character",
                     household_id = "character",
                     community_id = "character"),
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    d <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(input_file, sheet = 1,
                             colNames = TRUE, detectDates = FALSE)
  }
  for (id_col in c("individual_id", "household_id", "community_id")) {
    if (id_col %in% names(d)) d[[id_col]] <- as.character(d[[id_col]])
  }

  required_now <- c(
    "individual_id", "household_id", "community_id",
    "sex", "age", "marriage_status_raw",
    paste0("death_", yr), paste0("dibao_", yr),
    "num_children", "coresident_child",
    "household_income_per_capita", paste0("hukou_", yr)
  )

  missing_now <- setdiff(required_now, names(d))
  if (length(missing_now) > 0) {
    stop("Year ", yr, " is missing required column(s): ",
         paste(missing_now, collapse = ", "))
  }

  d$individual_id <- trimws(d$individual_id)
  d$household_id <- trimws(d$household_id)
  d$community_id <- trimws(d$community_id)

  if (yr == 2011) {
    d$individual_id <- standardize_2011_individual_id(d$individual_id)
    d$household_id <- standardize_2011_household_id(d$household_id)
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(d$individual_id)) {
    stop("Duplicated individual_id detected after standardization in year ", yr)
  }

  raw_list[[as.character(yr)]] <- d
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Build standardized person-wave table
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
person_wave_list <- list()

for (yr in waves) {
  d <- raw_list[[as.character(yr)]]

  get_or_na <- function(nm) {
    if (nm %in% names(d)) d[[nm]] else rep(NA, nrow(d))
  }

  pw <- data.frame(
    individual_id = d$individual_id,
    household_id = d$household_id,
    community_id = d$community_id,
    wave = yr,
    sex = safe_numeric(d$sex),
    age = safe_numeric(d$age),
    birth_year_used = safe_numeric(get_or_na("birth_year_used")),
    marriage_status_raw = safe_numeric(d$marriage_status_raw),
    num_children = safe_numeric(d$num_children),
    coresident_child_raw = safe_numeric(d$coresident_child),
    death = safe_numeric(d[[paste0("death_", yr)]]),
    dibao = safe_numeric(d[[paste0("dibao_", yr)]]),
    household_income_per_capita = safe_numeric(d$household_income_per_capita),
    hukou_raw = safe_numeric(d[[paste0("hukou_", yr)]]),
    death_year = safe_numeric(get_or_na("death_year")),
    death_month = safe_numeric(get_or_na("death_month")),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  if (any(!is.na(pw$sex) & !(pw$sex %in% c(1, 2)))) {
    stop("Unexpected sex code in year ", yr)
  }
  if (any(!is.na(pw$death) & !(pw$death %in% c(0, 1)))) {
    stop("Unexpected death code in year ", yr)
  }
  if (any(!is.na(pw$dibao) & !(pw$dibao %in% c(0, 1)))) {
    stop("Unexpected Dibao code in year ", yr)
  }
  if (any(!is.na(pw$coresident_child_raw) &
          !(pw$coresident_child_raw %in% c(0, 1)))) {
    stop("Unexpected coresident_child code in year ", yr)
  }
  if (any(!is.na(pw$hukou_raw) & !(pw$hukou_raw %in% c(1, 2)))) {
    stop("Unexpected hukou_", yr, " code: only 1, 2 or NA are allowed.")
  }

  person_wave_list[[as.character(yr)]] <- pw
}

person_wave <- do.call(rbind, person_wave_list)
person_wave <- person_wave[order(person_wave$individual_id, person_wave$wave), ]
rownames(person_wave) <- NULL

# Do not silently force household changes.
hh_per_person <- tapply(
  person_wave$household_id,
  person_wave$individual_id,
  function(z) length(unique(z[!is.na(z)]))
)
if (any(hh_per_person > 1)) {
  stop("At least one individual is linked to more than one household_id. ",
       "Inspect household linkage before modelling.")
}


# 4. Household-wave Dibao history
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
check_household_value <- function(df, variable, yr) {
  ss <- split(df[[variable]], df$household_id)
  n_unique <- vapply(
    ss,
    function(z) length(unique(z[!is.na(z)])),
    integer(1)
  )
  if (any(n_unique > 1)) {
    stop("Conflicting non-missing ", variable,
         " values within household-wave in year ", yr)
  }
}

hh_wave_list <- list()

for (yr in waves) {
  d <- person_wave[person_wave$wave == yr, ]
  check_household_value(d, "dibao", yr)
  check_household_value(d, "household_income_per_capita", yr)

  hh_split <- split(d, d$household_id)
  hh_one <- lapply(hh_split, function(g) {
    data.frame(
      household_id = g$household_id[1],
      wave = yr,
      dibao = one_nonmissing(g$dibao),
      income_wave = as.numeric(one_nonmissing(g$household_income_per_capita)),
      any_alive_record = any(g$death == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  hh_wave_list[[as.character(yr)]] <- do.call(rbind, hh_one)
}

household_wave <- do.call(rbind, hh_wave_list)
rownames(household_wave) <- NULL

# Model A long-term mean household per-capita income:
# (1) one observed income per household per wave, already checked above;
# (2) simple mean of all available waves, ignoring missing waves;
# (3) fixed per household across all start-stop intervals.
# Do not replace missing income with 0; genuine zero and negative income remain valid.
income_history <- split(household_wave$income_wave, household_wave$household_id)
household_income_A <- data.frame(
  household_id = names(income_history),
  long_mean_household_income_pc = vapply(income_history, function(x) {
    if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  }, numeric(1)),
  n_income_waves = vapply(income_history, function(x) {
    sum(!is.na(x))
  }, integer(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
if (anyDuplicated(household_income_A$household_id)) {
  stop("Duplicate household_id in long-term household income table.")
}

# Any explicit Yes -> Ever.
# No Yes + at least one explicit No + no ambiguous observed alive wave -> Never.
# Otherwise -> Unknown.
hh_split <- split(household_wave, household_wave$household_id)

household_history <- do.call(rbind, lapply(hh_split, function(g) {
  any_yes <- any(g$dibao == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  any_no <- any(g$dibao == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  ambiguous_observed <- any(g$any_alive_record & is.na(g$dibao))

  if (any_yes) {
    group <- "Ever"
    first_wave <- min(g$wave[g$dibao == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else if (any_no && !ambiguous_observed) {
    group <- "Never"
    first_wave <- NA_real_
  } else {
    group <- "Unknown"
    first_wave <- NA_real_
  }

  data.frame(
    household_id = g$household_id[1],
    dibao_group = group,
    first_dibao_wave = first_wave,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
rownames(household_history) <- NULL

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Fixed sex and death time at person level
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
person_split <- split(person_wave, person_wave$individual_id)

person_meta <- do.call(rbind, lapply(person_split, function(g) {
  g <- g[order(g$wave), ]
  g <- g[order(g$wave), , drop = FALSE]
  sx <- g$sex[!is.na(g$sex)]
  # First valid Hukou from any wave; deliberately applied to ALL intervals,
  # including intervals earlier than the first valid Hukou observation.
  valid_hukou_idx <- which(g$hukou_raw %in% c(1, 2))
  first_idx <- if (length(valid_hukou_idx) == 0) NA_integer_ else valid_hukou_idx[1]
  data.frame(
    individual_id = g$individual_id[1],
    household_id = g$household_id[1],
    sex_fixed = if (length(sx) == 0) NA_real_ else sx[1],
    sex_conflict = length(unique(sx)) > 1,
    hukou_fixed = if (is.na(first_idx)) NA_real_ else g$hukou_raw[first_idx],
    hukou_first_wave = if (is.na(first_idx)) NA_real_ else g$wave[first_idx],
    hukou_conflict = length(unique(g$hukou_raw[valid_hukou_idx])) > 1,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
rownames(person_meta) <- NULL

death_count <- vapply(
  person_split,
  function(g) sum(g$death == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
  numeric(1)
)
if (any(death_count > 1)) {
  stop("At least one person has death==1 in more than one wave.")
}

death_info <- do.call(rbind, lapply(person_split, function(g) {
  g <- g[order(g$wave), ]
  dead_rows <- g[g$death == 1, , drop = FALSE]
  alive_rows <- g[g$death == 0, , drop = FALSE]
  last_alive_wave <- if (nrow(alive_rows) == 0) NA_real_ else max(alive_rows$wave)

  if (nrow(dead_rows) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      individual_id = g$individual_id[1],
      death_confirmed = 0,
      death_report_wave = NA_real_,
      death_time = NA_real_,
      death_time_source = NA_character_,
      death_time_issue = NA_character_,
      last_alive_wave = last_alive_wave,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  d <- dead_rows[1, ]
  report_wave <- d$wave
  previous_alive <- alive_rows$wave[alive_rows$wave < report_wave]
  last_alive_before_report <-
    if (length(previous_alive) == 0) NA_real_ else max(previous_alive)

  raw_time <- NA_real_
  raw_source <- "missing"

  if (!is.na(d$death_year)) {
    if (!is.na(d$death_month) && d$death_month >= 1 && d$death_month <= 12) {
      raw_time <- d$death_year + (d$death_month - 0.5) / 12
      raw_source <- "reported_year_month"
    } else {
      raw_time <- d$death_year
      raw_source <- "reported_year"
    }
  } else if (!is.na(d$birth_year_used) && !is.na(d$age)) {
    raw_time <- d$birth_year_used + d$age
    raw_source <- "cleaned_death_age"
  }

  valid_raw <- !is.na(raw_time) &&
    raw_time <= report_wave &&
    (is.na(last_alive_before_report) || raw_time > last_alive_before_report)

  if (valid_raw) {
    final_time <- raw_time
    final_source <- raw_source
    issue <- NA_character_
  } else {
    if (is.na(raw_time)) {
      issue <- "death_time_missing"
    } else if (raw_time > report_wave) {
      issue <- "death_time_after_report_wave"
    } else if (!is.na(last_alive_before_report) &&
               raw_time <= last_alive_before_report) {
      issue <- "death_time_not_after_last_alive"
    } else {
      issue <- "death_time_invalid"
    }

    if (!is.na(last_alive_before_report)) {
      final_time <- (last_alive_before_report + report_wave) / 2
      final_source <- "fallback_midpoint"
    } else {
      final_time <- report_wave
      final_source <- "fallback_first_dead_wave"
    }
  }

  data.frame(
    individual_id = g$individual_id[1],
    death_confirmed = 1,
    death_report_wave = report_wave,
    death_time = final_time,
    death_time_source = final_source,
    death_time_issue = issue,
    last_alive_wave = last_alive_wave,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
rownames(death_info) <- NULL

person_meta <- merge(person_meta, household_history,
                     by = "household_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
person_meta <- merge(person_meta, death_info,
                     by = "individual_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Construct B1 start-stop intervals
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
start_data <- person_wave[
  person_wave$wave %in% start_waves & person_wave$death == 0,
  , drop = FALSE
]

start_data <- merge(
  start_data,
  person_meta[, c(
    "individual_id", "household_id",
    "sex_fixed", "sex_conflict", "hukou_fixed",
    "hukou_first_wave", "hukou_conflict",
    "dibao_group", "first_dibao_wave",
    "death_confirmed", "death_report_wave",
    "death_time", "death_time_source",
    "death_time_issue", "last_alive_wave"
  )],
  by = c("individual_id", "household_id"),
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

start_data$next_wave <- unname(next_wave_lookup[as.character(start_data$wave)])
start_data$observation_end <- ifelse(
  start_data$death_confirmed == 1,
  start_data$death_time,
  start_data$last_alive_wave
)
start_data$stop <- pmin(start_data$next_wave,
                        start_data$observation_end,
                        na.rm = FALSE)

# Event is explicitly initialized to 0 so NA cannot propagate silently.
start_data$event <- 0L
event_idx <-
  !is.na(start_data$death_confirmed) &
  start_data$death_confirmed == 1 &
  !is.na(start_data$death_time) &
  !is.na(start_data$stop) &
  start_data$death_time > start_data$wave &
  start_data$death_time <= start_data$stop
start_data$event[event_idx] <- 1L

if (anyNA(start_data$event)) {
  stop("Internal error: event contains NA after construction.")
}

start_data$marriage_status <- recode_marriage(start_data$marriage_status_raw)
start_data$living_children <- recode_children(start_data$num_children)
start_data$coresident_child <- recode_coresidence(start_data$coresident_child_raw)
start_data$age_group <- recode_age_group(start_data$age)
start_data$hukou <- factor(
  ifelse(start_data$hukou_fixed == 1, "Rural",
         ifelse(start_data$hukou_fixed == 2, "Urban", NA_character_)),
  levels = c("Rural", "Urban")
)
start_data$sex <- factor(
  ifelse(start_data$sex_fixed == 1, "Male",
         ifelse(start_data$sex_fixed == 2, "Female", NA)),
  levels = c("Male", "Female")
)

# Model A income definition: use the SAME five-wave household mean in every risk interval.
# Match by household_id; no new persons/intervals are created by this lookup.
start_data$long_mean_household_income_pc <-
  household_income_A$long_mean_household_income_pc[
    match(start_data$household_id, household_income_A$household_id)
  ]

start_data$eligible_group <- start_data$dibao_group %in% c("Ever", "Never")
start_data$eligible_age <- !is.na(start_data$age) & start_data$age >= 45
start_data$eligible_sex <- !is.na(start_data$sex_fixed)
start_data$eligible_income <- !is.na(start_data$long_mean_household_income_pc)
start_data$after_ever_entry <-
  start_data$dibao_group != "Ever" |
  (!is.na(start_data$first_dibao_wave) &
     start_data$wave >= start_data$first_dibao_wave)
start_data$positive_interval <- !is.na(start_data$stop) &
  start_data$stop > start_data$wave

analysis_intervals <- start_data[
  start_data$eligible_group &
    start_data$eligible_age &
    start_data$eligible_sex &
    start_data$eligible_income &
    start_data$after_ever_entry &
    start_data$positive_interval,
  , drop = FALSE
]

analysis_intervals$start <- analysis_intervals$wave
analysis_intervals$person_years <-
  analysis_intervals$stop - analysis_intervals$start


# 7. Model A fixed long-term income tertiles
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Exact cutoffs from Model A; printed to two decimal places in the manuscript.
# T1 <= q1; T2 (q1, q2]; T3 > q2. No wave-specific recalculation.
q1 <- 3924.44444444444
q2 <- 11548.3548148148
if (!is.finite(q1) || !is.finite(q2) || q1 >= q2) {
  stop("Invalid fixed Model A income cutoffs.")
}

fixed_income_cutoffs <- data.frame(
  income_definition = "Mean of available 2011-2020 household-wave per-capita annual income",
  income_unit = "CNY per person per year",
  T1_upper_inclusive = q1,
  T2_upper_inclusive = q2,
  n_households_with_income = sum(!is.na(household_income_A$long_mean_household_income_pc)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

analysis_intervals$income_tertile <- as.character(cut(
  analysis_intervals$long_mean_household_income_pc,
  breaks = c(-Inf, q1, q2, Inf),
  labels = c("T1", "T2", "T3"),
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  right = TRUE
))
if (anyNA(analysis_intervals$income_tertile)) {
  stop("Missing income tertile after filtering on Model A long-term mean income.")
}
# Verify that each household's income group stays fixed across intervals.
check_income_groups <- split(analysis_intervals$income_tertile,
                             analysis_intervals$household_id)
if (any(vapply(check_income_groups, function(z) length(unique(z)) > 1L,
               logical(1)))) {
  stop("A household's fixed long-term income tertile varies across intervals.")
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Final common interaction sample
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Match the final B1 Ever and Never main models: remove marriage Unknown from
# the fitted Cox sample, but do NOT merge it into another marital category.
marriage_unknown_idx <-
  !is.na(analysis_intervals$marriage_status) &
  as.character(analysis_intervals$marriage_status) == "Unknown"

marriage_unknown_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Never", "Ever"), function(gr) {
  d <- analysis_intervals[
    as.character(analysis_intervals$dibao_group) == gr & marriage_unknown_idx,
    , drop = FALSE
  ]
  data.frame(
    dibao_group = gr,
    excluded_intervals = nrow(d),
    excluded_persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
    excluded_deaths = sum(d$event, na.rm = TRUE),
    excluded_person_years = sum(d$person_years, na.rm = TRUE),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

model_data <- analysis_intervals[!marriage_unknown_idx, , drop = FALSE]

model_data$dibao_group <- factor(model_data$dibao_group,
                                 levels = c("Never", "Ever"))
model_data$sex <- factor(model_data$sex,
                         levels = c("Male", "Female"))
model_data$income_tertile <- factor(model_data$income_tertile,
                                    levels = c("T1", "T2", "T3"))
model_data$marriage_status <- factor(
  as.character(model_data$marriage_status),
  levels = c("Partnered", "Widowed", "Separated-Divorced", "Never married")
)
model_data$living_children <- factor(
  model_data$living_children,
  levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3+", "Unknown")
)
model_data$coresident_child <- factor(
  model_data$coresident_child,
  levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown")
)
model_data$age_group <- factor(
  model_data$age_group,
  levels = c("45-54", "55-64", "65-74", "75-84", "85-94", "95+")
)

# ADL/IADL are time-updated at the START of each B1 risk interval.
# Hukou above is fixed at the first valid observation across all five waves.
adl_wide <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file_adl, sheet = 1,
                                colNames = TRUE, detectDates = FALSE)
adl_columns <- paste0("adl_", waves)
iadl_columns <- paste0("iadl_", waves)
missing_adl_columns <- setdiff(c("individual_id", adl_columns, iadl_columns),
                               names(adl_wide))
if (length(missing_adl_columns) > 0) {
  stop("ADL/IADL wide file lacks: ", paste(missing_adl_columns, collapse = ", "))
}
adl_wide$individual_id <- trimws(as.character(adl_wide$individual_id))
adl_wide$individual_id <- standardize_2011_individual_id(adl_wide$individual_id)
if (anyNA(adl_wide$individual_id) || any(adl_wide$individual_id == "") ||
    anyDuplicated(adl_wide$individual_id)) {
  stop("ADL/IADL wide file has missing or duplicate individual_id values.")
}
for (nm in c(adl_columns, iadl_columns)) {
  adl_wide[[nm]] <- safe_numeric(adl_wide[[nm]])
}
all_adl <- unlist(adl_wide[adl_columns], use.names = FALSE)
all_iadl <- unlist(adl_wide[iadl_columns], use.names = FALSE)
if (any(!is.na(all_adl) & (all_adl < 0 | all_adl > 6))) {
  stop("ADL must be between 0 and 6, or NA.")
}
if (any(!is.na(all_iadl) & (all_iadl < 0 | all_iadl > 5))) {
  stop("IADL must be between 0 and 5, or NA.")
}

model_data$adl <- NA_real_
model_data$iadl <- NA_real_
for (yr in start_waves) {
  idx <- which(model_data$wave == yr)
  if (length(idx) == 0) next
  lookup <- match(model_data$individual_id[idx], adl_wide$individual_id)
  model_data$adl[idx] <- adl_wide[[paste0("adl_", yr)]][lookup]
  model_data$iadl[idx] <- adl_wide[[paste0("iadl_", yr)]][lookup]
}

# Consistent complete-case sample for ALL primary and simultaneous interactions.
# The Model A fixed long-term income cutoffs are not recalculated after exclusions.
model_data_before_new_filters <- model_data
new_missing_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Never", "Ever"), function(gr) {
  d <- model_data_before_new_filters[
    as.character(model_data_before_new_filters$dibao_group) == gr, , drop = FALSE
  ]
  excluded <- is.na(d$hukou) | is.na(d$adl) | is.na(d$iadl)
  data.frame(
    dibao_group = gr,
    original_persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
    excluded_persons = length(setdiff(unique(d$individual_id),
                                      unique(d$individual_id[!excluded]))),
    excluded_intervals = sum(excluded),
    excluded_deaths = sum(d$event[excluded]),
    missing_hukou_intervals = sum(is.na(d$hukou)),
    missing_adl_intervals = sum(is.na(d$adl)),
    missing_iadl_intervals = sum(is.na(d$iadl)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
model_data <- model_data[
  !is.na(model_data$hukou) & !is.na(model_data$adl) & !is.na(model_data$iadl),
  , drop = FALSE
]
if (nrow(model_data) == 0 ||
    any(vapply(c("Never", "Ever"), function(gr)
      sum(model_data$event[as.character(model_data$dibao_group) == gr]),
      numeric(1)) == 0)) {
  stop("After Hukou/ADL/IADL filtering, a Dibao group has no usable death events.")
}

required_model_vars <- c(
  "start", "stop", "event", "individual_id", "dibao_group",
  "sex", "income_tertile", "marriage_status",
  "living_children", "coresident_child", "age_group", "hukou", "adl", "iadl"
)
complete_model <- complete.cases(model_data[, required_model_vars])
if (!all(complete_model)) {
  stop(sum(!complete_model),
       " interaction-model interval(s) still contain missing required fields.")
}
if (any(model_data$stop <= model_data$start)) {
  stop("Non-positive risk interval detected in final interaction sample.")
}
if (sum(model_data$event) == 0) {
  stop("No deaths found in final interaction sample.")
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Compact sample summary and cell counts
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
sample_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Never", "Ever"), function(gr) {
  d <- model_data[as.character(model_data$dibao_group) == gr, , drop = FALSE]
  data.frame(
    dibao_group = gr,
    persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
    households = length(unique(d$household_id)),
    intervals = nrow(d),
    deaths = sum(d$event),
    person_years = sum(d$person_years),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

# Event/person counts for each comparison level, used directly in the final
# interaction result table so sparse cells are visible without extra QA files.
get_cell_counts <- function(variable, level, group_name) {
  d <- model_data[
    as.character(model_data$dibao_group) == group_name &
      as.character(model_data[[variable]]) == level,
    , drop = FALSE
  ]
  c(records = nrow(d),
    persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
    events = sum(d$event, na.rm = TRUE))
}


# 10. Interaction definitions: all 8 explanatory variables
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# B start-stop intervals with Model A fixed long-term household income.
# Other time-varying covariates (except fixed sex/Hukou/income) are from interval start.
# Models contain the same base covariates and separate age x Dibao baseline hazards.
# Primary: exclude Unknown-category interactions (but retain them as controls).
# AllLevels: also interact Unknown in living_children and coresident_child.
base_covariates <- c(
  "sex", "income_tertile", "marriage_status", "living_children",
  "coresident_child", "hukou", "adl", "iadl"
)

primary_specs <- list(
  sex = list(type = "category", reference = "Male", levels = c("Female")),
  income_tertile = list(type = "category", reference = "T1", levels = c("T2", "T3")),
  marriage_status = list(type = "category", reference = "Partnered",
                         levels = c("Widowed", "Separated-Divorced", "Never married")),
  living_children = list(type = "category", reference = "0", levels = c("1", "2", "3+")),
  coresident_child = list(type = "category", reference = "No", levels = c("Yes")),
  hukou = list(type = "category", reference = "Rural", levels = c("Urban")),
  adl = list(type = "numeric", reference = "Per 1 point", levels = "Per 1 point"),
  iadl = list(type = "numeric", reference = "Per 1 point", levels = "Per 1 point")
)

all_level_specs <- primary_specs
all_level_specs$living_children$levels <- c("1", "2", "3+", "Unknown")
all_level_specs$coresident_child$levels <- c("Yes", "Unknown")

# Each block tests H0: all Dibao interactions of this factor equal zero.
# Example: income_tertile has two interaction coefficients and a 2-df block test.
add_interaction_columns <- function(data, variable, spec) {
  interaction_names <- character(0)
  level_map <- data.frame(level = character(0), main_term = character(0),
                          interaction_term = character(0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (lev in spec$levels) {
    nm <- paste0("int_", variable, "_", safe_name(lev))
    if (spec$type == "numeric") {
      data[[nm]] <- as.numeric(as.character(data$dibao_group) == "Ever") *
        as.numeric(data[[variable]])
      main_term <- variable
    } else {
      data[[nm]] <- as.integer(
        as.character(data$dibao_group) == "Ever" &
          as.character(data[[variable]]) == lev
      )
      main_term <- paste0(variable, lev)
    }
    interaction_names <- c(interaction_names, nm)
    level_map <- rbind(level_map, data.frame(
      level = lev, main_term = main_term, interaction_term = nm,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  list(data = data, names = interaction_names, level_map = level_map)
}

build_formula <- function(interaction_names) {
  rhs <- c(base_covariates, interaction_names,
           "strata(age_group, dibao_group)")
  as.formula(paste("Surv(start, stop, event) ~", paste(rhs, collapse = " + ")))
}

get_cell_counts <- function(data, variable, level, group_name, type) {
  d <- data[as.character(data$dibao_group) == group_name, , drop = FALSE]
  if (type == "numeric") {
    d <- d[!is.na(d[[variable]]), , drop = FALSE]
  } else {
    d <- d[as.character(d[[variable]]) == level, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  c(intervals = nrow(d), persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
    events = sum(d$event))
}

interaction_rows <- function(fit, data, factor_name, spec, level_map, analysis_name) {
  rows <- list()
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(level_map))) {
    lev <- level_map$level[j]
    main_term <- level_map$main_term[j]
    int_term <- level_map$interaction_term[j]

    never_stats <- single_coef_stats(fit, main_term)
    ever_stats <- linear_combination_stats(
      fit, setNames(c(1, 1), c(main_term, int_term))
    )
    ratio_stats <- single_coef_stats(fit, int_term)
    never_ci <- hr_ci(never_stats)
    ever_ci <- hr_ci(ever_stats)
    ratio_ci <- hr_ci(ratio_stats)
    n <- get_cell_counts(data, factor_name, lev, "Never", spec$type)
    e <- get_cell_counts(data, factor_name, lev, "Ever", spec$type)

    rows[[j]] <- data.frame(
      analysis = analysis_name, factor = factor_name,
      reference_level = spec$reference, level = lev,
      Never_intervals = unname(n["intervals"]),
      Never_persons = unname(n["persons"]),
      Never_events = unname(n["events"]),
      Never_HR = unname(never_ci["HR"]),
      Never_lower_95 = unname(never_ci["lower_95"]),
      Never_upper_95 = unname(never_ci["upper_95"]),
      Never_p = unname(never_stats["p"]),
      Ever_intervals = unname(e["intervals"]),
      Ever_persons = unname(e["persons"]),
      Ever_events = unname(e["events"]),
      Ever_HR = unname(ever_ci["HR"]),
      Ever_lower_95 = unname(ever_ci["lower_95"]),
      Ever_upper_95 = unname(ever_ci["upper_95"]),
      Ever_p = unname(ever_stats["p"]),
      HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never = unname(ratio_ci["HR"]),
      ratio_lower_95 = unname(ratio_ci["lower_95"]),
      ratio_upper_95 = unname(ratio_ci["upper_95"]),
      interaction_p = unname(ratio_stats["p"]),
      sparse_level_flag = n["events"] < 5 || e["events"] < 5,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

# Run one factor's interaction while other factors have common (adjustment) HRs.
run_one_factor_set <- function(data, specs, analysis_name) {
  blocks <- list()
  levels <- list()
  ph_rows <- list()
  warnings <- character(0)
  for (target in names(specs)) {
    spec <- specs[[target]]
    z <- add_interaction_columns(data, target, spec)
    form <- build_formula(z$names)
    f <- tryCatch(fit_cox_with_warnings(form, z$data), error = function(e)
      list(fit = NULL, warnings = paste("FIT ERROR:", conditionMessage(e))))
    if (length(f$warnings) > 0) {
      warnings <- c(warnings, paste0(analysis_name, " / ", target, ": ", f$warnings))
    }
    if (is.null(f$fit)) {
      blocks[[target]] <- data.frame(
        analysis = analysis_name, factor = target,
        chisq = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_,
        PH_global_p = NA_real_, status = "FIT ERROR", stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      next
    }
    fit <- f$fit
    block <- wald_block(fit, z$names)
    ph <- safe_cox_zph(fit)
    blocks[[target]] <- data.frame(
      analysis = analysis_name, factor = target, chisq = block$chisq,
      df = block$df, p_value = block$p_value,
      PH_global_p = get_global_ph_p(ph), status = block$status,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    levels[[target]] <- interaction_rows(
      fit, z$data, target, spec, z$level_map, analysis_name)
    ph_rows[[target]] <- data.frame(
      analysis = analysis_name, factor = target,
      PH_global_p = get_global_ph_p(ph), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  list(block = do.call(rbind, blocks),
       levels = do.call(rbind, levels),
       ph = if (length(ph_rows) == 0) data.frame() else do.call(rbind, ph_rows),
       warnings = unique(warnings[nzchar(warnings)]))
}

# Fit ALL interactions together: each factor's heterogeneity is conditional on
# the other factors being allowed to differ across Never/Ever.
run_full_set <- function(data, specs, analysis_name) {
  d <- data
  maps <- list()
  block_terms <- list()
  for (target in names(specs)) {
    z <- add_interaction_columns(d, target, specs[[target]])
    d <- z$data
    maps[[target]] <- z$level_map
    block_terms[[target]] <- z$names
  }
  all_terms <- unlist(block_terms, use.names = FALSE)
  form <- build_formula(all_terms)
  f <- tryCatch(fit_cox_with_warnings(form, d), error = function(e)
    list(fit = NULL, warnings = paste("FIT ERROR:", conditionMessage(e))))
  if (is.null(f$fit)) {
    block <- data.frame(
      analysis = analysis_name, factor = names(specs),
      chisq = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_,
      PH_global_p = NA_real_, status = "FIT ERROR", stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    return(list(block = block,
                levels = data.frame(status = "FIT ERROR", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
                warnings = f$warnings))
  }
  fit <- f$fit
  ph <- safe_cox_zph(fit)
  blocks <- lapply(names(specs), function(target) {
    x <- wald_block(fit, block_terms[[target]])
    data.frame(
      analysis = analysis_name, factor = target,
      chisq = x$chisq, df = x$df, p_value = x$p_value,
      PH_global_p = get_global_ph_p(ph), status = x$status,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  levels <- lapply(names(specs), function(target) {
    interaction_rows(fit, d, target, specs[[target]],
                     maps[[target]], analysis_name)
  })
  list(block = do.call(rbind, blocks), levels = do.call(rbind, levels),
       warnings = f$warnings)
}

# 11. The four analyses correspond to the structure of Model A interaction.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
primary <- run_one_factor_set(model_data, primary_specs, "Primary_Substantive")
all_levels <- run_one_factor_set(model_data, all_level_specs, "Sensitivity_AllLevels")
full_primary <- run_full_set(model_data, primary_specs, "Full_Substantive")
full_all <- run_full_set(model_data, all_level_specs, "Full_AllLevels")

# 12. Summarize sample, risk intervals, sparse categories, and model warnings
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
sample_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Never", "Ever"), function(gr) {
  d <- model_data[as.character(model_data$dibao_group) == gr, , drop = FALSE]
  data.frame(
    dibao_group = gr,
    persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
    households = length(unique(d$household_id)),
    intervals = nrow(d),
    deaths = sum(d$event),
    person_years = sum(d$person_years),
    hukou_conflict_persons = length(unique(d$individual_id[d$hukou_conflict])),
    future_first_hukou_intervals = sum(d$hukou_first_wave > d$start, na.rm = TRUE),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

results_levels <- list(
  Primary_Substantive = primary$levels,
  Sensitivity_AllLevels = all_levels$levels,
  Full_Substantive = full_primary$levels,
  Full_AllLevels = full_all$levels
)
results_blocks <- list(
  Primary_Substantive = primary$block,
  Sensitivity_AllLevels = all_levels$block,
  Full_Substantive = full_primary$block,
  Full_AllLevels = full_all$block
)
# Repeat the global per-factor Wald test on the corresponding level rows.
# This keeps the original B primary CSV useful for direct interpretation.
primary_combined <- primary$levels
if (nrow(primary_combined) > 0) {
  ix <- match(primary_combined$factor, primary$block$factor)
  primary_combined$block_chisq <- primary$block$chisq[ix]
  primary_combined$block_df <- primary$block$df[ix]
  primary_combined$block_p <- primary$block$p_value[ix]
  primary_combined$PH_global_p <- primary$block$PH_global_p[ix]
  primary_combined$block_status <- primary$block$status[ix]
}

model_warnings <- unique(c(primary$warnings, all_levels$warnings,
                           full_primary$warnings, full_all$warnings))
model_warnings <- model_warnings[nzchar(model_warnings)]
warning_table <- data.frame(
  message = if (length(model_warnings) == 0) "No Cox fitting warnings" else model_warnings,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

summary_table <- data.frame(
  item = c("Method", "Income definition", "Hukou definition", "ADL/IADL definition",
           "Model comparison", "Ever entry rule", "Reference group",
           "Never persons", "Never deaths", "Never intervals",
           "Ever persons", "Ever deaths", "Ever intervals",
           "Full substantive GLOBAL PH p", "Full all-level GLOBAL PH p"),
  value = as.character(c(
    "B start-stop Cox interactions with Model A long-term fixed household income",
    "2011-2020 available-wave mean household income per capita; fixed Model A cutoffs 3924.44444444444 / 11548.3548148148",
    "First valid across 2011-2020; Rural=1 (reference), Urban=2; fixed in all intervals",
    "Wave-specific ADL 0-6 / IADL 0-5 at interval start, complete-case sample",
    "One-factor-at-a-time and full simultaneous interactions, primary plus all-level sensitivity",
    "Ever enters from first observed Dibao Yes wave onward",
    "Never Dibao for HR ratio Ever/Never; separate age x Dibao strata",
    sample_summary$persons[sample_summary$dibao_group == "Never"],
    sample_summary$deaths[sample_summary$dibao_group == "Never"],
    sample_summary$intervals[sample_summary$dibao_group == "Never"],
    sample_summary$persons[sample_summary$dibao_group == "Ever"],
    sample_summary$deaths[sample_summary$dibao_group == "Ever"],
    sample_summary$intervals[sample_summary$dibao_group == "Ever"],
    full_primary$block$PH_global_p[1],
    full_all$block$PH_global_p[1]
  )),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 13. Write one Excel workbook plus the original primary-results CSV
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Same output folder, distinct result name to avoid overwriting the wave-specific version.
excel_file <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "B_Dibao_Interaction_results_longterm_income.xlsx")
csv_file <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "B_Dibao_Interaction_results_longterm_income.csv")
wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
add_output <- function(sheet, tab) {
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, sheet)
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, sheet, tab)
}
add_output("Summary", summary_table)
add_output("Sample_QA", sample_summary)
add_output("NewMissing_QA", new_missing_summary)
add_output("Income_Cutoffs", fixed_income_cutoffs)
add_output("Primary_Block", primary$block)
add_output("Primary_Levels", primary_combined)
add_output("AllLevels_Block", all_levels$block)
add_output("AllLevels_Levels", all_levels$levels)
add_output("FullPrimary_Block", full_primary$block)
add_output("FullPrimary_Levels", full_primary$levels)
add_output("FullAll_Block", full_all$block)
add_output("FullAll_Levels", full_all$levels)
add_output("Model_Warnings", warning_table)
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, excel_file, overwrite = TRUE)
write.csv(primary_combined, csv_file, row.names = FALSE, na = "")

cat("\nB all-variable interaction with Model A fixed long-term income: completed.\n")
cat("Output: ", excel_file, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Primary overall factor-level interaction tests:\n")
print(primary$block, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Full simultaneous model interaction tests:\n")
print(full_primary$block, row.names = FALSE)
```

#Final
```{r}
# as the updated Model A and Model B1 Ever/Never analyses.
#
# Main analysis: one Dibao interaction at a time for 8 factors; ALL 8
# factors remain adjusted in EVERY model. Other factors' HRs are common
# between Dibao groups in each one-factor interaction model.
# Sensitivity: all 8 factors allowed to interact simultaneously.
# Unknown missingness categories are controls in substantive models and
# additionally interacted only in separate all-level sensitivity models.
# ADL and IADL interact separately in primary analysis, and simultaneously
# in full interaction models. NO ADL:IADL or three-way interaction is fitted.
#
# Data sources (same working directory):
#   A_Cox_outputs/A_Cox_common_data.rds
#   CHARLS_2011_2020_wide_ADL_IADL.xlsx
# Mandatory sample verification against BOTH renamed Model B1 M4 workbooks.
# No raw CHARLS files are reread, no source data are modified.
# B1 samples are checked against the renamed Ever/Never Excel result tables.
# Preparing this script does NOT execute any statistical analysis.
# ================================================================

# 0. Packages and paths
# Use the working directory containing the A_Cox_outputs folder,
# the ADL/IADL wide Excel file, and the TWO renamed B1 result workbooks.
DATA_DIR <- "."
A_DIR <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "A_Cox_outputs")
COMMON_RDS <- file.path(A_DIR, "A_Cox_common_data.rds")
ADL_FILE <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "CHARLS_2011_2020_wide_ADL_IADL.xlsx")
B1_EVER_XLSX <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Model B1_Ever_ADL_IADL_Cox_results.xlsx")
B1_NEVER_XLSX <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Model B1_Never_ADL_IADL_Cox_results.xlsx")

# OUTPUT_DIR is a FOLDER, not an Excel filename.
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "B_Interaction_outputs")
OUTPUT_XLSX <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "Model B2_Dibao_Interaction_results.xlsx")
OUTPUT_RDS <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "Model B2_Dibao_Interaction_ADL_IADL_results.rds")
MIN_EVENTS_PER_GROUP_LEVEL <- 5L

needed_packages <- c("survival", "readxl", "openxlsx")
missing_packages <- needed_packages[
  !vapply(needed_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages)) {
  stop("Install R packages first: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
}
library(survival)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Require ALL current input files. Do not silently fall back to stale names.
required_files <- c(
  Model_A_common_RDS = COMMON_RDS,
  ADL_IADL_wide_Excel = ADL_FILE,
  Model_B1_Ever_results = B1_EVER_XLSX,
  Model_B1_Never_results = B1_NEVER_XLSX
)
missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]
if (length(missing_files)) {
  stop("Required input files not found (names must match exactly):\n",
       paste(names(missing_files), unname(missing_files), sep = ": ",
             collapse = "\n"))
}
if (file.exists(OUTPUT_DIR) && !dir.exists(OUTPUT_DIR)) {
  stop("Output directory path already exists as a FILE: ", OUTPUT_DIR)
}
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "csv"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 1. Read, verify, and filter the original Method A risk intervals.
a_common <- readRDS(COMMON_RDS)
required_parts <- c("analysis_intervals", "income_cutoffs", "person_meta")
if (!all(required_parts %in% names(a_common))) {
  stop("Outdated/incomplete Model A RDS; missing: ",
       paste(setdiff(required_parts, names(a_common)), collapse = ", "))
}
if (!all(c("q1", "q2") %in% names(a_common$income_cutoffs))) {
  stop("Model A RDS has no named income cutoffs q1 and q2.")
}
q1 <- as.numeric(a_common$income_cutoffs["q1"])
q2 <- as.numeric(a_common$income_cutoffs["q2"])
if (!all(is.finite(c(q1, q2))) || q1 >= q2) {
  stop("Invalid Model A household income tertile cutoffs.")
}

base <- a_common$analysis_intervals
needed_cols <- c(
  "individual_id", "household_id", "wave", "start", "stop", "event",
  "dibao_group", "sex", "income_tertile", "marriage_status",
  "living_children", "coresident_child", "hukou", "hukou_fixed",
  "hukou_first_wave", "age_group", "long_mean_household_income_pc"
)
if (!all(needed_cols %in% names(base))) {
  stop("Model A common intervals are missing: ",
       paste(setdiff(needed_cols, names(base)), collapse = ", "))
}
base <- base[as.character(base$dibao_group) %in% c("Never", "Ever"), , drop = FALSE]
if (!nrow(base)) stop("Model A data have no Ever/Never intervals.")
base$individual_id <- trimws(as.character(base$individual_id))
base$household_id <- trimws(as.character(base$household_id))
base$wave <- as.integer(as.character(base$wave))
if (anyNA(base$individual_id) || any(base$individual_id == "") ||
    anyNA(base$wave) || any(!base$wave %in% c(2011L, 2013L, 2015L, 2018L))) {
  stop("Bad respondent ID or start wave in Model A intervals.")
}
if (anyNA(base$start) || anyNA(base$stop) ||
    any(!is.finite(base$start)) || any(!is.finite(base$stop)) ||
    any(base$stop <= base$start) ||
    anyNA(base$event) || any(!base$event %in% c(0L, 1L))) {
  stop("Invalid start/stop/event fields in Model A intervals.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(base[, c("individual_id", "start")])) {
  stop("Duplicate respondent-start risk intervals in Model A common data.")
}

# Validate fixed HUKOU exactly as in latest A/B1.
if (any(!is.na(base$hukou_fixed) & !base$hukou_fixed %in% c(1, 2))) {
  stop("Expected HUKOU raw codes 1=agricultural, 2=non-agricultural.")
}
expected_hukou <- ifelse(is.na(base$hukou_fixed), NA_character_,
                         ifelse(base$hukou_fixed == 1,
                                "Agricultural", "Non-agricultural"))
if (!identical(as.character(base$hukou), expected_hukou) ||
    any(is.na(base$hukou_fixed) != is.na(base$hukou_first_wave))) {
  stop("Inconsistent fixed HUKOU in common Model A RDS.")
}
expected_income <- ifelse(base$long_mean_household_income_pc <= q1, "T1",
                          ifelse(base$long_mean_household_income_pc <= q2,
                                 "T2", "T3"))
if (anyNA(expected_income) ||
    anyNA(base$income_tertile) ||
    !identical(as.character(base$income_tertile), as.character(expected_income))) {
  stop("Income tertiles differ from the saved Model A cutoffs.")
}

# Exactly follow B1: marriage Unknown excluded first, then HUKOU missing.
marriage_unknown <- base[is.na(base$marriage_status) |
                           as.character(base$marriage_status) == "Unknown", , drop = FALSE]
marriage_kept <- base[!is.na(base$marriage_status) &
                        as.character(base$marriage_status) != "Unknown", , drop = FALSE]
hukou_missing <- marriage_kept[is.na(marriage_kept$hukou), , drop = FALSE]
original <- marriage_kept[!is.na(marriage_kept$hukou), , drop = FALSE]
if (!nrow(original)) stop("No eligible risk intervals after Model A filters.")

set_factors <- function(d) {
  d$dibao_group <- factor(as.character(d$dibao_group), levels = c("Never", "Ever"))
  d$sex <- factor(as.character(d$sex), levels = c("Male", "Female"))
  d$income_tertile <- factor(as.character(d$income_tertile), levels = c("T1", "T2", "T3"))
  d$marriage_status <- factor(as.character(d$marriage_status),
                              levels = c("Partnered", "Widowed", "Separated-Divorced", "Never married"))
  d$living_children <- factor(as.character(d$living_children),
                              levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3+", "Unknown"))
  d$coresident_child <- factor(as.character(d$coresident_child),
                               levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown"))
  d$hukou <- factor(as.character(d$hukou),
                    levels = c("Non-agricultural", "Agricultural"))
  d$age_group <- factor(as.character(d$age_group),
                        levels = c("45-54", "55-64", "65-74", "75-84", "85-94", "95+"))
  d
}
original <- set_factors(original)
adjustment_vars <- c("sex", "income_tertile", "marriage_status", "living_children",
                     "coresident_child", "hukou", "age_group", "dibao_group")
if (anyNA(original[, adjustment_vars, drop = FALSE])) {
  stop("Missing model covariates after matching the latest Model A/B1 rules.")
}
if (any(table(original$dibao_group) == 0L) ||
    any(tapply(original$event, original$dibao_group, sum) < 1L)) {
  stop("Both Dibao groups require observations and deaths.")
}

# 2. Link ADL/IADL from EXACTLY the same interval-start wave as Model B1.
adl_wide <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel(ADL_FILE, sheet = 1))
waves <- c(2011L, 2013L, 2015L, 2018L, 2020L)
adl_cols <- paste0("adl_", waves)
iadl_cols <- paste0("iadl_", waves)
needed_adl_cols <- c("individual_id", adl_cols, iadl_cols)
if (!all(needed_adl_cols %in% names(adl_wide))) {
  stop("ADL/IADL wide file is missing: ",
       paste(setdiff(needed_adl_cols, names(adl_wide)), collapse = ", "))
}
adl_wide$individual_id <- trimws(as.character(adl_wide$individual_id))
if (anyNA(adl_wide$individual_id) || any(adl_wide$individual_id == "") ||
    anyDuplicated(adl_wide$individual_id)) {
  stop("ADL/IADL wide file contains missing/duplicate respondent IDs.")
}
score_to_numeric <- function(x, col_name, maximum) {
  txt <- trimws(as.character(x))
  missing <- is.na(txt) | txt %in% c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL")
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(txt))
  if (any(!missing & (is.na(num) | !is.finite(num))) ||
      any(!is.na(num) & (num < 0 | num > maximum))) {
    stop("Invalid ADL/IADL values in column: ", col_name)
  }
  num
}
for (nm in adl_cols) adl_wide[[nm]] <- score_to_numeric(adl_wide[[nm]], nm, 6)
for (nm in iadl_cols) adl_wide[[nm]] <- score_to_numeric(adl_wide[[nm]], nm, 5)
missing_ids <- setdiff(unique(original$individual_id), adl_wide$individual_id)
if (length(missing_ids)) {
  stop(length(missing_ids), " A model respondents absent from ADL/IADL wide file. ",
       "Use the identical wide file used in both Model B1 runs.")
}
adl_long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(waves, function(yr) {
  data.frame(individual_id = adl_wide$individual_id, wave = yr,
             adl = adl_wide[[paste0("adl_", yr)]],
             iadl = adl_wide[[paste0("iadl_", yr)]],
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
if (anyDuplicated(adl_long[, c("individual_id", "wave")])) {
  stop("Duplicate ADL/IADL respondent + wave keys.")
}
match_original <- match(paste(original$individual_id, original$wave, sep = "|"),
                        paste(adl_long$individual_id, adl_long$wave, sep = "|"))
if (anyNA(match_original)) stop("Missing respondent-wave join keys for ADL/IADL.")
original$adl <- adl_long$adl[match_original]
original$iadl <- adl_long$iadl[match_original]

# Same ADL and IADL joint complete-case interval subset as BOTH B1 M4 models.
dat <- original[!is.na(original$adl) & !is.na(original$iadl), , drop = FALSE]
if (!nrow(dat) || anyNA(dat[, c(adjustment_vars, "adl", "iadl"), drop = FALSE])) {
  stop("No valid complete-case sample for B2 interaction models.")
}
if (any(table(dat$dibao_group) == 0L) ||
    anyNA(tapply(dat$event, dat$dibao_group, sum)) ||
    any(tapply(dat$event, dat$dibao_group, sum) < 1L)) {
  stop("At least one Dibao group has no observations/deaths in joint ADL/IADL sample.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(dat[, c("individual_id", "start")])) {
  stop("Duplicate respondent-start intervals after complete-case selection.")
}
check_overlap <- function(d) {
  d <- d[order(d$individual_id, d$start, d$stop), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(d) < 2L) return(FALSE)
  same <- d$individual_id[-1L] == d$individual_id[-nrow(d)]
  overlap <- d$start[-1L] < d$stop[-nrow(d)]
  any(same & overlap)
}
if (check_overlap(dat)) stop("Overlapping risk intervals found for respondents.")

# 3. MANDATORY cross-check with SAVED B1 Ever/Never M4 results.
# The exact renamed result workbooks must exist. Never rerun B1.
check_b1_file <- function(path, gr) {
  d <- dat[as.character(dat$dibao_group) == gr, , drop = FALSE]
  observed <- c(persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
                intervals = nrow(d), deaths = sum(d$event))
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("B1 results workbook is missing: ", path)
  cmp <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(path, sheet = "Model_Comparison")
  if (!all(c("Model", "Persons", "Intervals", "Deaths") %in% names(cmp))) {
    stop("B1 workbook missing Model_Comparison fields: ", path)
  }
  target <- cmp[as.character(cmp$Model) == "M4_ADL_IADL", , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(target) != 1L) stop("B1 workbook has no single M4_ADL_IADL row: ", path)
  expected <- c(persons = as.numeric(target$Persons),
                intervals = as.numeric(target$Intervals),
                deaths = as.numeric(target$Deaths))
  if (anyNA(expected) || any(!is.finite(expected)) ||
      !isTRUE(all(observed == expected))) {
    stop("B2 sample differs from B1 M4 for ", gr,
         ". Check common RDS/wide file versions and the renamed B1 results.")
  }
  data.frame(group = gr, B1_workbook_found = TRUE,
             persons_B2 = observed["persons"], intervals_B2 = observed["intervals"],
             deaths_B2 = observed["deaths"], persons_B1 = expected["persons"],
             intervals_B1 = expected["intervals"], deaths_B1 = expected["deaths"],
             status = "PASS", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
b1_sample_check <- rbind(check_b1_file(B1_NEVER_XLSX, "Never"),
                         check_b1_file(B1_EVER_XLSX, "Ever"))

# 4. Sample and event distributions (for interpretation/QA only).

  z <- d[as.character(d$dibao_group) == gr, , drop = FALSE]
  data.frame(group = gr, persons = length(unique(z$individual_id)),
             households = length(unique(z$household_id)),
             intervals = nrow(z), deaths = sum(z$event),
             person_years = sum(z$stop - z$start), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

  marriage_drop <- marriage_unknown[as.character(marriage_unknown$dibao_group) == gr, , drop = FALSE]
  hukou_drop <- hukou_missing[as.character(hukou_missing$dibao_group) == gr, , drop = FALSE]
  orig <- original[as.character(original$dibao_group) == gr, , drop = FALSE]
  common <- dat[as.character(dat$dibao_group) == gr, , drop = FALSE]
  data.frame(group = gr,
             intervals_before_model_exclusions = nrow(all),

             hukou_missing_deaths = sum(hukou_drop$event),
             B1_original_intervals = nrow(orig),
             adl_iadl_missing_intervals = nrow(orig) - nrow(common),
             adl_iadl_missing_deaths = sum(orig$event) - sum(common$event),
             B1_M4_intervals = nrow(common),
             B1_M4_deaths = sum(common$event),
             fixed_hukou_recorded_after_interval_start =
               sum(common$hukou_first_wave > common$wave, na.rm = TRUE),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

                        source = "The existing Model A public RDS; never recomputed")

categorical_qa <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(categorical_levels), function(var) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(dat[[var]]), function(lev) {
    do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Never", "Ever"), function(gr) {
      z <- dat[as.character(dat$dibao_group) == gr &
                 as.character(dat[[var]]) == lev, , drop = FALSE]
      data.frame(group = gr, factor = var, level = lev,
                 persons = length(unique(z$individual_id)),
                 intervals = nrow(z), deaths = sum(z$event),
                 person_years = sum(z$stop-z$start), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }))
  }))
}))
continuous_qa <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("adl", "iadl"), function(var) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Never", "Ever"), function(gr) {
    z <- dat[as.character(dat$dibao_group) == gr, var]
    data.frame(group = gr, factor = var, intervals = length(z),
               min = min(z), median = median(z), mean = mean(z),
               sd = sd(z), max = max(z),
               unique_values = length(unique(z)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}))

# For primary categorical interaction levels: >=5 deaths in BOTH groups.
# For continuous ADL/IADL: at least 5 group deaths and observed variation.
primary_eligibility <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(primary_specs), function(var) {
  if (var %in% c("adl", "iadl")) {
    out <- lapply(c("Never", "Ever"), function(gr) {
      d <- dat[as.character(dat$dibao_group) == gr, , drop = FALSE]
      data.frame(factor = var, level = "per 1 point", group = gr,
                 deaths = sum(d$event),
                 eligible = sum(d$event) >= MIN_EVENTS_PER_GROUP_LEVEL &&
                   length(unique(d[[var]])) >= 2L,
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    })
  } else {
    out <- lapply(c("Never", "Ever"), function(gr) {
      do.call(rbind, lapply(primary_specs[[var]], function(lev) {
        z <- categorical_qa[categorical_qa$factor == var &
                              categorical_qa$level == lev &
                              categorical_qa$group == gr, , drop = FALSE]
        data.frame(factor = var, level = lev, group = gr,
                   deaths = z$deaths[1],
                   eligible = nrow(z) == 1L &&
                     z$deaths[1] >= MIN_EVENTS_PER_GROUP_LEVEL,
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      }))
    })
  }
  do.call(rbind, out)
}))
if (anyNA(primary_eligibility$eligible) || any(!primary_eligibility$eligible)) {
  bad <- primary_eligibility[is.na(primary_eligibility$eligible) |
                               !primary_eligibility$eligible, , drop = FALSE]
  stop("Some primary interaction levels have insufficient events/variation:\n",
       paste(paste(bad$factor, bad$level, bad$group, bad$deaths), collapse = "\n"))
}

# 5. Model definitions and statistics.
base_rhs <- c("sex", "income_tertile", "marriage_status", "living_children",
              "coresident_child", "hukou", "adl", "iadl")
safe_name <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)

add_interactions <- function(d, specs) {
  all_names <- character()
  level_map <- data.frame(factor = character(), level = character(),
                          main_term = character(), int_term = character(),
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (var in names(specs)) {
    for (lev in specs[[var]]) {
      nm <- paste0("int_", var, "_", safe_name(lev))
      if (var %in% c("adl", "iadl")) {
        d[[nm]] <- ifelse(as.character(d$dibao_group) == "Ever", d[[var]], 0)
        main <- var
      } else {
        d[[nm]] <- as.integer(as.character(d$dibao_group) == "Ever" &
                                as.character(d[[var]]) == lev)
        main <- paste0(var, lev)
      }
      all_names <- c(all_names, nm)
      level_map <- rbind(level_map,
                         data.frame(factor = var, level = lev,
                                    main_term = main, int_term = nm,
                                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
  }
  list(data = d, interaction_names = all_names, map = level_map)
}

make_formula <- function(int_names) {
  stats::as.formula(paste("survival::Surv(start, stop, event) ~",
                          paste(c(base_rhs, int_names,
                                  "strata(age_group, dibao_group)"),
                                collapse = " + ")))
}
fit_with_warnings <- function(formula, d) {
  warnings_seen <- character()
  fit <- withCallingHandlers(
    survival::coxph(formula, data = d, ties = "efron",
                    cluster = individual_id, robust = TRUE,
                    x = TRUE, model = TRUE),
    warning = function(w) {
      warnings_seen <<- c(warnings_seen, conditionMessage(w))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )
  list(fit = fit, warnings = unique(warnings_seen))
}
coef_stats <- function(fit, weights) {
  b <- coef(fit)
  vv <- vcov(fit)
  if (any(!names(weights) %in% names(b))) {
    return(c(beta = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }
  sel <- names(weights)
  if (any(!is.finite(b[sel])) || any(!is.finite(vv[sel, sel, drop = FALSE]))) {
    return(c(beta = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }
  est <- sum(b[sel] * weights)
  v <- as.numeric(t(weights) %*% vv[sel, sel, drop = FALSE] %*% weights)
  if (!is.finite(v) || v <= 0) return(c(beta = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  se <- sqrt(v)
  c(beta = est, se = se, p = 2 * pnorm(abs(est / se), lower.tail = FALSE))
}
hr_from_stats <- function(x) {
  if (any(!is.finite(x))) {
    return(c(HR = NA_real_, low = NA_real_, high = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }
  c(HR = unname(exp(x["beta"])),
    low = unname(exp(x["beta"] - qnorm(.975) * x["se"])),
    high = unname(exp(x["beta"] + qnorm(.975) * x["se"])),
    p = unname(x["p"]))
}
wald_test <- function(fit, terms) {
  b <- coef(fit)
  V <- vcov(fit)
  if (!all(terms %in% names(b))) {
    return(data.frame(chisq = NA_real_, df = NA_integer_,
                      p_value = NA_real_, status = "Missing interaction terms"))
  }
  bb <- b[terms]
  vv <- V[terms, terms, drop = FALSE]
  if (any(!is.finite(bb)) || any(!is.finite(vv))) {
    return(data.frame(chisq = NA_real_, df = length(terms),
                      p_value = NA_real_, status = "Nonfinite estimate/covariance"))
  }
  eig <- eigen(vv, symmetric = TRUE)
  tol <- max(abs(eig$values)) * 1e-10
  good <- eig$values > tol
  if (!any(good)) {
    return(data.frame(chisq = NA_real_, df = 0L,
                      p_value = NA_real_, status = "Zero-rank covariance"))
  }
  invert <- eig$vectors[, good, drop = FALSE] %*%
    diag(1/eig$values[good], nrow = sum(good)) %*%
    t(eig$vectors[, good, drop = FALSE])
  stat <- as.numeric(t(bb) %*% invert %*% bb)
  df <- sum(good)
  full_rank <- (df == length(terms))
  data.frame(chisq = stat, df = df,
             p_value = if (full_rank) pchisq(stat, df, lower.tail = FALSE)
                       else NA_real_,
             status = if (full_rank) "OK" else "Reduced rank - no valid full block p")
}
ph_diagnostic <- function(fit, formula, d, name) {
  source <- "clustered robust Cox fit"
  primary_error <- NA_character_
  ph <- tryCatch(survival::cox.zph(fit, transform = "km", terms = TRUE,
                                  global = TRUE), error = function(e) e)
  if (inherits(ph, "error")) {
    primary_error <- conditionMessage(ph)
    source <- "same formula, unclustered PH-only fallback"
    fallback <- tryCatch(survival::coxph(formula, data = d, ties = "efron",
                                        x = TRUE, model = TRUE), error = function(e) e)
    ph <- if (inherits(fallback, "error")) fallback else
      tryCatch(survival::cox.zph(fallback, transform = "km", terms = TRUE,
                                global = TRUE), error = function(e) e)
  }
  if (inherits(ph, "error")) {
    return(list(object = NULL,
                table = data.frame(model = name, term = "PH_TEST_ERROR",
                                   chisq = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, p = NA_real_,
                                   diagnostic_source = source,
                                   message = paste(primary_error, conditionMessage(ph)))))
  }
  tb <- as.data.frame(ph$table)
  list(object = ph,
       table = data.frame(model = name, term = rownames(tb),
                          chisq = as.numeric(tb$chisq), df = as.numeric(tb$df),
                          p = as.numeric(tb$p), diagnostic_source = source,
                          message = primary_error, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}

reference_labels <- c(sex = "Male", income_tertile = "T1",
                      marriage_status = "Partnered", living_children = "0",
                      coresident_child = "No", hukou = "Non-agricultural")
make_level_rows <- function(fit, map, analysis) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(map)), function(i) {
    mn <- map$main_term[i]
    it <- map$int_term[i]
    never <- hr_from_stats(coef_stats(fit, setNames(1, mn)))
    ever <- hr_from_stats(coef_stats(fit, setNames(c(1, 1), c(mn, it))))
    ratio <- hr_from_stats(coef_stats(fit, setNames(1, it)))
    data.frame(analysis = analysis, factor = map$factor[i],
               comparison = if (map$factor[i] %in% c("adl", "iadl")) {
                 paste0(toupper(map$factor[i]), " per 1 point")
               } else {
                 paste0(map$level[i], " vs ", reference_labels[[map$factor[i]]])
               },
               Never_HR = unname(never["HR"]),
               Never_lower_95 = unname(never["low"]),
               Never_upper_95 = unname(never["high"]),
               Never_p = unname(never["p"]),
               Ever_HR = unname(ever["HR"]),
               Ever_lower_95 = unname(ever["low"]),
               Ever_upper_95 = unname(ever["high"]),
               Ever_p = unname(ever["p"]),
               HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never = unname(ratio["HR"]),
               ratio_lower_95 = unname(ratio["low"]),
               ratio_upper_95 = unname(ratio["high"]),
               interaction_p = unname(ratio["p"]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}

# 6. Eight separate interactions: primary inference.
run_one_by_one <- function(d, specs, analysis) {
  models <- list()
  blocks <- list()
  levels <- list()
  coefficients <- list()
  ph_tables <- list()
  ph_objects <- list()
  warnings <- list()
  for (var in names(specs)) {
    added <- add_interactions(d, setNames(list(specs[[var]]), var))
    form <- make_formula(added$interaction_names)
    fit_obj <- fit_with_warnings(form, added$data)
    fit <- fit_obj$fit
    models[[var]] <- fit
    w <- wald_test(fit, added$interaction_names)
    blocks[[var]] <- data.frame(analysis = analysis, factor = var, w,
                               n_terms = length(added$interaction_names))
    levels[[var]] <- make_level_rows(fit, added$map, analysis)
    coefficients[[var]] <- data.frame(analysis = analysis, factor_tested = var,
                                       term = names(coef(fit)), beta = as.numeric(coef(fit)),
                                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    ph <- ph_diagnostic(fit, form, added$data, paste(analysis, var, sep = "_"))
    ph_tables[[var]] <- ph$table
    ph_objects[[var]] <- ph$object
    if (length(fit_obj$warnings)) {
      warnings[[var]] <- data.frame(analysis = analysis, model = var,
                                   warning = fit_obj$warnings)
    }
  }
  list(models = models, blocks = do.call(rbind, blocks),
       levels = do.call(rbind, levels),
       coefficients = do.call(rbind, coefficients),
       ph = do.call(rbind, ph_tables), ph_objects = ph_objects,
       warnings = if (length(warnings)) do.call(rbind, warnings) else NULL)
}

# 7. All eight factors interacting simultaneously: sensitivity analyses.
run_full <- function(d, specs, analysis) {
  added <- add_interactions(d, specs)
  form <- make_formula(added$interaction_names)
  fit_obj <- fit_with_warnings(form, added$data)
  fit <- fit_obj$fit
  map <- added$map
  blocks <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(specs), function(var) {
    terms <- map$int_term[map$factor == var]
    data.frame(analysis = analysis, factor = var, wald_test(fit, terms),
               n_terms = length(terms))
  }))
  levels <- make_level_rows(fit, map, analysis)
  ph <- ph_diagnostic(fit, form, added$data, analysis)
  warnings <- if (length(fit_obj$warnings)) {
    data.frame(analysis = analysis, model = "All eight simultaneous",
               warning = fit_obj$warnings)
  } else NULL
  list(model = fit, blocks = blocks, levels = levels,
       coefficients = data.frame(analysis = analysis, term = names(coef(fit)),
                                 beta = as.numeric(coef(fit))),
       ph = ph$table, ph_object = ph$object, warnings = warnings)
}

primary <- run_one_by_one(dat, primary_specs, "Primary_Substantive")
all_level <- run_one_by_one(dat, all_level_specs, "Sensitivity_AllLevels")
full_sub <- run_full(dat, primary_specs, "Full_Substantive")
full_all <- run_full(dat, all_level_specs, "Full_AllLevels")

# 8. Gather outputs and diagnostics.
all_level_eligibility <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(all_level_specs), function(var) {
  if (var %in% c("adl", "iadl")) return(NULL)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Never", "Ever"), function(gr) {
    do.call(rbind, lapply(all_level_specs[[var]], function(lev) {
      z <- categorical_qa[categorical_qa$factor == var &
                            categorical_qa$level == lev &
                            categorical_qa$group == gr, , drop = FALSE]
      data.frame(factor = var, level = lev, group = gr,
                 deaths = if (nrow(z)) z$deaths[1] else NA_integer_,
                 sparse = !nrow(z) || z$deaths[1] < MIN_EVENTS_PER_GROUP_LEVEL,
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }))
  }))
}))

warnings_all <- Filter(Negate(is.null),
                       list(primary$warnings, all_level$warnings,
                            full_sub$warnings, full_all$warnings))
model_warnings <- if (length(warnings_all)) do.call(rbind, warnings_all) else
  data.frame(analysis = "None", model = "None",
             warning = "No Cox fitting warnings captured")

# Holm correction across EIGHT pre-specified PRIMARY block tests.
# NA remains NA for a non-estimable interaction block.
primary$blocks$holm_p <- p.adjust(primary$blocks$p_value, method = "holm")
# A significant individual coefficient does not replace a factor block test.

write.csv(model_warnings,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "csv", "B_Interaction_Model_Warnings.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(list(
  method = "Model B, Phase 2, A-aligned B1 M4 sample",
  income_cutoffs = c(q1 = q1, q2 = q2),
  sample_summary = sample_summary, phase1_b1_check = b1_sample_check,
  exclusion_qa = exclusion_qa, primary_eligibility = primary_eligibility,
  model_data = dat,
  primary = primary, all_level = all_level,
  full_substantive = full_sub, full_all_levels = full_all,
  warnings = model_warnings
), OUTPUT_RDS)

capture.output(sessionInfo(),
               file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "B_Interaction_sessionInfo.txt"))

# PH plots for primary interactions and the full substantive model.
for (var in names(primary$ph_objects)) {
  ph <- primary$ph_objects[[var]]
  if (!is.null(ph)) {
    grDevices::pdf(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0("B_Interaction_PH_", var, ".pdf")))
    try(plot(ph), silent = TRUE)
    grDevices::dev.off()
  }
}
if (!is.null(full_sub$ph_object)) {
  grDevices::pdf(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "B_Interaction_PH_FullSub.pdf"))
  try(plot(full_sub$ph_object), silent = TRUE)
  grDevices::dev.off()
}

cat("\nMODEL B PHASE 2 | EIGHT-FACTOR EVER-vs-NEVER INTERACTION\n")
cat("All eight covariates are adjusted in every Cox model.\n")
cat("Primary: one interaction at a time. FullSub: all eight simultaneously.\n")
cat("HUKOU: agricultural vs non-agricultural (reference).\n")
cat("ADL/IADL: separate per-point interactions in primary; both interact in FullSub.\n")
cat("Rows/deaths must match the respective B1 M4 samples.\n\n")
print(sample_summary, row.names = FALSE)
print(b1_sample_check, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nPRIMARY INTERACTION BLOCK TESTS (Holm-adjusted p also shown):\n")
print(primary$blocks, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nPRIMARY INTERACTION HR RATIOS:\n")
print(primary$levels[, c("factor", "comparison", "Never_HR", "Ever_HR",
                         "HR_ratio_Ever_vs_Never", "ratio_lower_95",
                         "ratio_upper_95", "interaction_p")], row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nSIMULTANEOUS EIGHT-FACTOR INTERACTION BLOCK TESTS:\n")
print(full_sub$blocks, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nGLOBAL PH diagnostics (FullSub):\n")
print(full_sub$ph[full_sub$ph$term %in% c("GLOBAL", "PH_TEST_ERROR"), , drop = FALSE],
      row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nSaved: ", OUTPUT_XLSX, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Saved: ", OUTPUT_RDS, "\n", sep = "")
```
